verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs show a drag-and-drop email editor where users can edit content, appearance and module locations, plus starter templates such as event, newsletter and engagement layouts. That covers the visual editor and template parts of the story, but nothing in the pack documents personalization tokens, brand kits for email, or rendering across email clients. The AI per-contact rewrite claim (docs-22) is a different capability from personalization tokens and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented personalization tokens, on-brand controls (brand kit or saved styles) for email, cross-client rendering or preview testing, evidence that templates are saved and reused rather than only starter layouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Once you've created a marketing email, you can edit its content, appearance, and module locations.
For example, you can use event, newsletter, engagement templates, and more.
